[SWS_DM_00380] Support for S3 timer
⌈
The Diagnostic Server in-
stance shall provide support for S3Server (session timeout) with a fixed value of 5 sec-
ond. The timer handling shall be implemented according to ISO 14229-2[13].
⌋
